It is only possible to join the church if you are in BitNode 13 or possess at least one level of Source File 13, and you will be turned away if you have purchased or installed any augmentations beside NeuroFlux Governors. You are, however, permitted to install augmentations as normal once you have joined the church.

ddf91c936e6b.en: Initially, those bearing the gift will find that its overwhelming power worsens all of their stats by 10%. This penalty can be overcome in time by receiving free upgrades from the Church of the Machine God faction, but the reputation requirements for these upgrades are steep, and you can only obtain reputation with the church by charging the gift.

1b4765abacec.en: In order to charge Stanek's Gift, the user must first arrange stat-modifying fragments within the grid located on the device. This may be done manually or by scripts that utilize the Stanek's Gift Netscript API. Not every tile of the grid must house a fragment, but fragments cannot overlap or otherwise share tiles. Fragments can be rotated, but their design does not allow them to be flipped around to mirror their original shape. Note that the size of the grid is determined by the BitNode you are currently in and the level of your Source File 13, if applicable.
1b4765abacec.ko: 스타넥의 선물을 충전하려면 먼저 장치의 그리드 안에 능력치를 올려 주는 프래그먼트를 배치해야 합니다. 직접 배치하거나 스타넥의 선물 Netscript API를 사용하는 스크립트로 배치할 수 있습니다. 그리드의 모든 칸에 프래그먼트가 있을 필요는 없지만, 프래그먼트끼리 겹치거나 칸을 공유할 수는 없습니다. 프래그먼트는 회전할 수 있으나 설계상 뒤집어서 거울상으로 만들 수는 없습니다. 그리드의 크기는 현재 비트노드와 소스 파일 13의 레벨(있는 경우)에 따라 정해집니다.

393b5c985024.en: There exist two kinds of fragments. The first are Stat Fragments, which take up 4 tiles of the grid. Each Stat Fragment is unique, and there is only one of each. There is no way to obtain more of these fragments. Each Stat Fragment has an associated stat that it will improve, as well as a multiplier on its effectiveness known as power. When initially placed, a Stat Fragment will have no effect. In order for the fragment to gain stat boosts, it must be charged. The other kind of fragments are known as Booster Fragments, which take up 5 tiles of the grid. There is no shortage of Booster Fragments, and it is virtually impossible to run out of them. While not providing any direct stat increases to their user, Booster Fragments increase the efficacy of adjacent Stat Fragments by 10%, and do not need to be charged. Multiple Booster Fragments can affect the same Stat Fragment.
393b5c985024.ko: 프래그먼트에는 두 종류가 있습니다. 첫 번째는 스탯 프래그먼트로, 그리드 4칸을 차지합니다. 스탯 프래그먼트는 각각 고유하며 종류별로 하나뿐이고, 더 얻을 방법은 없습니다. 각 스탯 프래그먼트에는 향상시키는 능력치와 효과 배율인 위력이 정해져 있습니다. 처음 배치했을 때는 아무 효과가 없으며, 능력치 보너스를 얻으려면 충전해야 합니다. 다른 종류는 부스터 프래그먼트로, 그리드 5칸을 차지합니다. 부스터 프래그먼트는 부족할 일이 거의 없어서 다 쓰는 것이 사실상 불가능합니다. 사용자에게 직접 능력치를 올려 주지는 않지만 인접한 스탯 프래그먼트의 효율을 10% 높여 주며 충전할 필요가 없습니다. 여러 부스터 프래그먼트가 같은 스탯 프래그먼트에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

3cc621b455e6.en: Stat Fragments are charged using the stanek.chargeFragment(rootX, rootY) NetScript API function. The charging process ordinarily takes 1000ms to complete, but only takes 200ms during bonus time. When the function finishes executing, the fragment's charge levels will be raised by an amount corresponding to the number of threads that were used. Note that it is generally more effective to charge a fragment a few times with many threads than to charge it many times with few threads, so there is a benefit to combining charging jobs into fewer scripts. As a Stat Fragment's charge level is increased, its bonuses will increase, but there will be diminishing returns. As such, it is generally most efficient to charge all of the placed fragments equally. The charge level of a fragment will not decrease over time, but it will be reset to 0 upon removing it from the board or installing augmentations.
3cc621b455e6.ko: 스탯 프래그먼트는 stanek.chargeFragment(rootX, rootY) Netscript API 함수로 충전합니다. 충전은 보통 1000ms가 걸리지만 보너스 타임에는 200ms면 끝납니다. 함수 실행이 끝나면 사용한 스레드 수에 비례해 프래그먼트의 충전량이 늘어납니다. 적은 스레드로 여러 번 충전하는 것보다 많은 스레드로 몇 번만 충전하는 편이 일반적으로 효율적이므로, 충전 작업을 더 적은 수의 스크립트로 합치는 것이 좋습니다. 스탯 프래그먼트의 충전량이 늘면 보너스도 커지지만 효율은 점점 떨어집니다. 따라서 배치한 프래그먼트를 모두 고르게 충전하는 것이 가장 효율적입니다. 충전량은 시간이 지나도 줄지 않지만, 보드에서 제거하거나 증강을 설치하면 0으로 초기화됩니다.

7ccd620e2471.en: The gift is a grid on which you can place upgrades called fragments. The main type of fragment increases a stat, like your hacking skill or agility exp. Once a stat fragment is placed it then needs to be charged via scripts in order to become useful. The other kind of fragments are called booster fragments. They increase the efficiency of the neighboring fragments (not diagonally). Use Q/E to rotate fragments.
